sunoData.title: Tender Reunion
sunoData.tags: Ambient game music, slow 72 BPM with soft piano motifs, warm felt pads, brushed mallet pulses, and a gentle harp ostinato; verse space stays sparse with close harmonic shifts, the middle section blooms with cello and glassy synth swells, then the final section thins back to piano and pad for intimate dialogue support. Breath-like risers, reversed chime tails, and subtle reverb blooms mark transitions. Intimate close-mic mix, wide and polished, soft-edged and emotional., ambient, soft, romantic, emotional
